docRequirement: `changelog.md` (re-fetched 2026-08-03, 5258 lines, md5 a346d16e7ea073de689a2bcefdbbb3c3), line 20, under `<Update label="2.1.219" description="July 24, 2026">`: "Added `DirectoryAdded` hook that fires after `/add-dir` or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request registers a new working directory mid-session". Three bindings, all inside that one sentence: (1) `DirectoryAdded` — that exact spelling — is a hook event a plugin or settings file may bind to as of 2.1.219; (2) it has TWO triggers and one of them is the CLI slash command `/add-dir`, so this is a CLI-level event and not SDK-only, the other being the SDK `register_repo_root` control request; (3) it fires *after* the registration, i.e. post-hoc/observational — a hook cannot veto the add. The changelog does not spell the payload; the sibling pages that do (`agent-sdk/typescript.md` `DirectoryAddedHookInput` = `{ hook_event_name: "DirectoryAdded"; directory: string; source: "slash_command" | "register_repo_root" }`, and the `### DirectoryAdded` section of `hooks.md`) are the citations for f079 and f000 respectively — same one gap, three pages.
current: `DirectoryAdded` exists nowhere in our code: `grep -ran DirectoryAdded packages apps scripts` -> 0 hits (`-a`, so this repo's NUL-byte files are covered; the only repo-wide hits are this sweep's own files under `docs/superpowers/specs/`). Neither trigger the changelog names exists either: `grep -ran 'register_repo_root|registerRepoRoot' packages apps` -> 0 hits, and there is no `/add-dir` slash command — every `add-dir` hit in source is `--add-dir` prose about rule loading (`packages/shared/src/capabilities/types.ts:197-201`, `packages/shared/src/capabilities/native-sources.ts:69,927`). Gate by gate: (1) `CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP` has exactly 28 entries and no `DirectoryAdded` — `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:123-152`, under the doc comment at `:117-122` reading "28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events". (2) `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS` holds exactly `MessageDisplay` and `TeammateIdle` — `format-adapters.ts:99-102`, comment `:87-98`. (3) `PluginHookEventName` carries 30 names and not this one — `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:25-55`, comment `:12-19` ("hooks.md enumerates 30 events; we emit 28 of them"); the roster array `PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENTS` matches at `:156-189`. (4) `PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENT_TO_AGENT_EVENT` — `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:372-403`, `satisfies Record<PluginHookEventName, AgentEvent | null>` — has no row. (5) `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` (`packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:37-102`) has `CwdChanged` at `:72` and `FileChanged` at `:73`, nothing for a directory add; `AgentEvent` derives at `:105`, `AGENT_EVENTS` at `:114`. (6) `EventPayloadMap` (`packages/shared/src/automations/event-bus.ts:78-118`) lists `CwdChanged`/`FileChanged` at `:106-107`, no key for it. (7) The matcher-value switch in `packages/shared/src/automations/utils.ts:185-239` has no case, and the event is in neither `MATCHERLESS_AGENT_EVENTS` (`utils.ts:260-269`) nor `MATCHER_IGNORED_AGENT_EVENTS` (`hooks-automation.ts:358-361`). (8) No emitter: the ONLY mid-session working-directory add we own is `case 'addDirectories'` in `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:3193-3214`, reached from a hook's `updatedPermissions`, refused unless `destination === 'session'` (`:3194-3199`), appending to `sessionAdditionalDirectories` at `:3207-3211` and emitting nothing. Consequence at the import boundary, verified separately from the identifier: `mapExternalHookEventName` (`format-adapters.ts:622-646`) resolves strictly dialect table -> deferral table -> warning with NO generic fallback arm, so a Claude plugin declaring a `DirectoryAdded` hook gets the `warning`-severity diagnostic `plugin.format.unknown_hook_event` ("External hook event \"DirectoryAdded\" is not mapped for claude compatibility.") at `:638-644`, and `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:1308-1319` then files the GENERIC `plugin.deferred.claude_hook_event_unsupported` at `:1315` because `mapped.deferredReasonCode` is undefined. A user hand-writing the name into a hooks-config file is rejected at `packages/shared/src/automations/hooks-config.ts:136-139` ("<source>: DirectoryAdded is not an agent lifecycle hook event"); the zod layer instead silently filters it (`packages/shared/src/automations/schemas.ts:197-215`, `VALID_EVENTS`); a runtime hook registration naming it is dropped at `packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-automations.ts:204`.
divergence: The whole event is missing — not a renamed key, not a wrong value. Two separable deltas, and the changelog sentence pins both halves. (a) IMPORT CLASSIFICATION IS WRONG FOR A DOCUMENTED EVENT: the adapter's own stated rule at `format-adapters.ts:634-635` — "A documented-but-unemitted event is a deferral, not an unknown name" — is not applied here, only because the name never reached `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS`. So the author gets BOTH a typo-shaped `plugin.format.unknown_hook_event` warning AND an unrouted generic deferral, where `MessageDisplay`/`TeammateIdle` get a clean routed reason. (b) THE EVENT IS UNIMPLEMENTED: no union member, no `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` row, no `EventPayloadMap` key, no payload carrying `directory`/`source`, no matcher projection, and no emit at the one directory-add path we own (`pi-agent.ts:3211`). Specific to THIS page's wording: the changelog names `/add-dir` as a trigger, so the event is not something we can dismiss as SDK-only — but we have neither trigger, and our single programmatic path can only ever justify `source: "register_repo_root"`; the documented `slash_command` value stays unproducible until a `/add-dir` equivalent exists. Stale as a side effect of the same release: the counts "30 documented events" (`hooks-runtime.ts:13`), "28 of the 30" (`format-adapters.ts:118`) and the identical phrase in the test comment (`format-adapters.test.ts:3690`) predate 2.1.219 and are now short by one.

blastRadius: Crosses a persistence boundary AND a package boundary — a risk trigger in this repo. `AGENT_EVENTS` (derived from `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1`) is the accepted vocabulary for on-disk automations config and is read by five independent gates I verified: `packages/shared/src/automations/schemas.ts:198-202` builds `VALID_EVENTS` and `AutomationsConfigSchema` (:204-220) silently filters unknown event keys out of a parsed file; `packages/shared/src/automations/hooks-config.ts:25,137` errors instead; `packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-automations.ts:32,200,204` gates live registration; `packages/shared/src/automations/automation-system.ts:50,226` partitions app vs agent events; `packages/shared/src/automations/management.ts:5,360` classifies an automation as agentic. Widening is forward-compatible for existing files, but a config written with `DirectoryAdded` is silently dropped (schema) or errors (hooks-config) on an OLDER build — that is the release-ordering risk. Type-enforced fan-out inside `packages/shared`: `PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENT_TO_AGENT_EVENT` (`hooks-automation.ts:372-403`) fails typecheck until updated; `PluginHookEventName` is imported by `format-adapters.ts:11`, `hooks-automation.ts` and `plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts`. TWO hand-mirrored rosters that no type checks — both 13-event subsets that already omit `CwdChanged`/`FileChanged`, so sibling parity needs no change, but they are why a `DirectoryAdded` automation cannot be created by either the agent or the UI even after the union widens: the agent-facing tool's own literal list at `packages/session-tools-core/src/handlers/automation-management.ts:56`, enforced at `:174` ("Agentic automations require an agent event.") and `:212`, and the renderer picker's `AgentEvent`/`AGENT_EVENTS` at `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/automations/types.ts:33-59`. The Pi subprocess also mirrors the roster by literal rather than by import — `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.test.ts:16,87`, `packages/pi-agent-server/src/__tests__/extension-first/behavior-contract.test.ts:19` and the fixture `packages/pi-agent-server/src/__tests__/extension-first/fixtures/behavior-corpus.json:914,976` — so those lists drift silently unless updated, and the shipped copies under `apps/electron/resources/` (e.g. `resources/session-mcp-server/index.js:147331,147364,147430`) need a rebuild, not just a source edit. Direct test callers of the mapping: `packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/format-adapters.test.ts:3689-3707`. NOT affected: the identically-named `AgentEvent` in the Pi SDK message-type union is a different subsystem.
userImpact: Today, concretely: a user installs a Claude plugin built against 2.1.219+ whose `hooks/hooks.json` declares a `DirectoryAdded` hook. The install succeeds, that hook is dropped from the plugin's capability list, and the install result carries the warning `External hook event "DirectoryAdded" is not mapped for claude compatibility.` — which reads as a typo in the plugin rather than a known Nessy gap, unlike `MessageDisplay`/`TeammateIdle`, which import as routed deferrals. The Sources UI does not render plugin diagnostics, so inside the desktop app the visible outcome is just a hook silently missing from the plugin; the wording surfaces through the marketplace/install RPC response and the agent-facing plugin-management tool result. A user hand-writing `DirectoryAdded` into a hooks-config file gets the load error `<source>: DirectoryAdded is not an agent lifecycle hook event`; the same key in an automations config file is dropped without any message. Beyond the wording, nothing that hook declares would run even if the name were accepted: we ship neither trigger the changelog names — no `/add-dir` command, no `register_repo_root` control request — so the only mid-session directory add is another hook granting `updatedPermissions.addDirectories` at session scope (`pi-agent.ts:3193-3214`), which fires no event. What would make the full gap surface is shipping a user-facing add-working-directory action; until then, the observable part is the misclassified install warning.
